title: The Ask Yi I Ching: a Chinese–English translation of the I Ching (Edition 2)
description:
A complete English translation of the I Ching (Zhouyi, 周易) with the Chinese text beside it: the Judgment and six lines of all 64 hexagrams, plus the extra texts for hexagrams 1 and 2. 450 passages in total, translated by manpo for Ask Yi.

The readings mainly follow Huang Shouqi and Zhang Shanwen, Zhouyi Yizhu (黄寿祺、张善文《周易译注》). The English translates the original text, not the commentary; where a word can be read more than one way, the English takes the reading that fits each passage.

Files: data/iching.json (everything in one file), data/hexagrams.csv, data/lines.csv. Read online or download the PDF at https://askyi.app/i-ching-pdf/

Credit: The Ask Yi I Ching, translated by manpo. https://askyi.app
